page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top left. A woodcut initial opens the paragraph beginning "IDEO". Gathering signature at the bottom right.

main_text.p: appareat,damnatum ab iis Aristotelem,qui e-ius libros nunquam aspexerant.

Quotuplex singulorum locorum firmamē-tum est? Omnium ferè locorum triplex est. primum est essentiæ,quam οὐσίαν Græci dicūt, qua respondetur ad quæstionem an sit.sic enim esse in rerum natura,quod quæritur, ex alterius comparatione confirmatur.binorū quippe inter se collatio utriusque essentiam ostendit. Alterum est convenientiæ, quam Græci ἀναλογίαν,Latini proportionem nominat [?]: qua respondetur vel ad quæstionem, quale sit: vel quæ eius causa sit.Tertium est reciprocationis,quam iidem ἀντιστροφῶ dicunt.Primum in binis tantùm affectionibus versatur, alterum in ternis aut quaternis:tertium in utrisque.
main_text.head: De quadruplici locorum quæstione.
CAP. VIII.
main_text.p: IDEO ista: sed quæro nonne quæstio an sit,potius ad Physicos,& naturæ indagatores,quàm ad Dialeticos pertinet, qui solam verborum consecutionem inquirunt? Dialectici non nudam verborum consecutionem exquirunt:sed consecutionem rerum & verborum in eloquendo.Itaque quicquid tota philosophia quæri & dubitari potest,quicquid denique ullo in genere cadere in disquisitionem potest,id omne

page.notes: The woodcut initial "I" of "IDEO" is read as "I". The Greek words οὐσίαν, ἀναλογίαν and ἀντιστροφῶ are read from a small scan and should be checked. Marks over "dicūt" and "nominat" are read as tildes; "nominat" is doubtful, marked [?]. The "nónne" accent is printed and kept as "nonne". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and u/v and i/j are normalised. The signature at the foot right is read as "a" and may be "a" followed by a mark.
